species.name: Trout
why: Water 62°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 6–32 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 65 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 62°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–28 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 65 ft, so fish stay above it.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
